summary: First full test run of ZOZOCIRCLE (backend + frontend). Created a pytest regression suite (71 tests, 68 passing = 95.8%) covering auth/RBAC, discovery (radius/Haversine/type/category/search/price/rating/sort), listing detail + whatsapp-click, favourites, seller onboarding + listing CRUD + image upload, admin stats/sellers/listings/categories, and bcrypt/cookie checks. Playwright covered Home, Explore, Listing detail, Saved, Auth, Seller onboarding->dashboard->add/edit/toggle/delete listing, Admin (all 4 tabs), Account/logout, PWA and responsiveness (390x844 + 1440). Two CRITICAL frontend/config defects found: (1) the location bottom-sheet is unusable on Home and Explore (manual locality fallback broken), (2) image upload returns 502 because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing from backend/.env, and the UI fails silently. Seed demo state (3 pending sellers/3 pending listings, categories) was restored after testing.

critical.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is absent from /app/backend/.env (and from the container env), so init_storage() -> POST integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init returns 400 'emergent_key is required' and every upload returns 502 'Image upload failed'. Real image upload for seller listings/logos is completely non-functional.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401, no lockout (playbook requires lockout after 5 failures, expected 423/429).

CORS_ORIGINS="*" in backend/.env while login sets a credentialed httpOnly cookie. Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * + credentials is invalid per spec; browsers drop the cookie for cross-origin calls. Use the explicit preview origin.
Accepts a non-existent listing_id and creates a favourite row (returns 200). Orphan rows are silently skipped by GET /api/favorites; should return 404.
min_rating/max_price are applied only when truthy, so radius_km/min_rating=0 style falsy filters are silently ignored (e.g. max_price=0). Low impact but inconsistent.
No DELETE endpoint - test/typo categories can only be disabled, never removed.
require_seller() also allows role=admin; an admin without a seller profile gets 404s instead of a clear error. Also no GET /api/health or root /api ping for uptime checks.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: the bottom-sheet overlay `fixed inset-0` is contained by the sticky header, which uses `backdrop-blur-xl` (backdrop-filter creates a containing block for fixed descendants). Measured overlay height = 76px on Home and 168px on Explore instead of 844px, so the sheet renders above the viewport (locality buttons at top:-377px) and 'Use my current location' / all locality buttons are unclickable. Since automation/most desktop users have no geolocation permission, the app is stuck on the 'Share your location' gate with no working fallback. Works correctly on /account (no backdrop-blur header). Fix: render the sheet in a React portal to document.body, or remove backdrop-filter from the header.
Upload fails with 502 and the UI shows NO error state - no toast, no error text, no preview; the user cannot tell the upload failed. Add error handling for the /api/upload failure.
React warning on submit: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (SellerOnboard)' - a setState/navigate is being called during render.
GET /api/seller/listings fires and returns 404 twice for a seller with no profile yet (console errors on every fresh seller). Should check profile existence / handle 404 gracefully.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed from Home or Explore due to the sheet containing-block bug; only workaround is localStorage zz_loc or the /account picker.
Upload 502; listings can only be created without images.

issues: Header reads '21 results within 2 km' while no location is set and no distances are shown - misleading copy; should say 'all nearby sellers' or hide the radius wording until a location exists.
'More around you' section renders its heading with an empty body when there are no extra items (only 1-2 results in radius) - hide empty sections.
Category icon strip is horizontally clipped at the right edge on 1440 desktop with no scroll affordance.
Constrained to max-w-2xl (~672px) centered on 1920px, leaving very large empty margins; the sellers/listings tables would benefit from a wider desktop layout.
manifest.json declares only 1 icon; add both 192x192 and 512x512 (plus maskable) for installability.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to /app/backend/.env (it is missing) so object-storage init succeeds and POST /api/upload + GET /api/files/{path} work; then re-test seller image upload.

CRITICAL: Fix the location bottom-sheet - render LocationPicker's sheet through a portal to document.body (or drop backdrop-blur-xl from the Home/Explore sticky headers) so the manual locality fallback works.
HIGH: Surface an error state (toast/inline text) when /api/upload fails in AddListing/SellerOnboard image uploaders.
MEDIUM: Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with the explicit preview origin since login uses credentialed cookies.
MEDIUM: Add login brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (423/429) per the auth playbook.

LOW: Return 404 from POST /api/favorites/{id} for unknown listings; fix the setState-during-render warning in SellerOnboard; avoid the 404 /api/seller/listings call before a profile exists; add a DELETE /api/admin/categories/{slug}.
Optional cleanup: purge leftover docs whose names start with TEST (3 seller profiles now set to 'rejected', 2 disabled 'test-cat-*' categories, and TEST_* users) from MongoDB.
critical_code_review_comments: components/LocationBits.jsx: a `fixed inset-0` modal must not be nested inside an element with backdrop-filter/transform - use createPortal(document.body).
server.py: init_storage() raises on every call when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is unset; log a clear startup-fatal warning and return 503 with an actionable message instead of a generic 502.
server.py listings(): `if min_rating:` / `if max_price:` should be `is not None` checks.
server.py: allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid; cookies will be rejected cross-origin.
server.py: no rate limiting / lockout on /api/auth/login.
AddListing.jsx: the upload call has no catch/error UI - every API call needs loading/success/error states.

success_rate.backend: 96% (68/71 pytest; 3 failures = upload 502, no login lockout, wildcard CORS)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (all flows verified except manual location sheet on Home/Explore and image upload)

Seed demo state restored: 'food' category re-enabled, 'Doorstep Bike Service' reverted to pending; admin/stats now shows 3 pending sellers and 3 pending listings as designed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: admin login+dashboard (overview stats, approve/verify/reject/suspend seller, approve/reject/delete listing, add category, toggle category incl. disappearing from public GET /api/categories), customer+seller registration, Home (radius 1/2/5 km changes result counts, real Haversine distances, category chips, popular/services sections, images render), Explore (search yoga/tailor, ALL/PRODUCTS/SERVICES tabs, max-price filter), listing detail (name/price/distance/rating/gallery, wa.me link with correct product vs service wording, whatsapp-click increments), Save/Saved/unsave, full seller flow (profile -> pending badge -> add product/service -> toggle -> edit (resets to pending) -> delete), approval makes a listing discoverable within radius (pytest test_seller_flow 14-15), RBAC (401 unauth, 403 customer/seller on admin), bottom nav hidden on /login /register /admin /seller* /listing/*, PWA manifest+sw.js served and 1 SW registration, logout clears zz_token. Because the location sheet is broken on Home/Explore, seed the location with localStorage: zz_loc = {"lat":12.9352,"lng":77.6245,"name":"Koramangala, Bengaluru","source":"manual"} and zz_radius=5, then reload. Re-run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` for regression; test_seller_flow.py is order-dependent within its class (module-scoped ctx dict) so keep it on one xdist worker (loadscope already does this).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Image upload 502: server.py init_storage() posts {'emergent_key': os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY')} to the object-store /init endpoint; the variable does not exist in /app/backend/.env nor in the pod env, so the proxy responds 400 'emergent_key is required' and upload()/get_file() raise 502/404. Repro: POST /api/upload with any image + a valid seller token. Fix: set EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env and restart backend. 2) Location sheet unusable: the sheet's overlay uses `fixed inset-0`, but its ancestor header has `backdrop-blur-xl` (backdrop-filter), which per CSS spec makes that header the containing block for fixed-position descendants. Measured: overlay rect height 76px on Home / 168px on Explore vs viewport 844px; locality buttons land at top:-377px, so Playwright (and real users) cannot click them. /account has no blurred header and the identical sheet works there, confirming the RCA. Fix: portal the sheet to document.body.
